lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the exposed mid-section. Spacing is relatively consistent across the mid-torso with slight widening toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the most anterior line segment near the dorsal ridge; a second minor bifurcation is observed on the fourth line from the anterior position.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 6th, 7th, and 8th vertical lines exhibit fragmentation into distinct dots or short dashes near the ventral-lateral transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking on the bridge of the snout and prominent white transverse bands on the forelimbs.
